# QiMétéo (QiMeteo) — Personal Decision Weather · Qi Men Dun Jia, BaZi & Tong Shu (iOS)

> QiMétéo (also searched without accent as **QiMeteo** or **Qi Meteo**) is a native iPhone and iPad application (`iOS 17+`) created by Xavier Larrodé that translates classical Chinese timing arts — **Qi Men Dun Jia** (`奇門遁甲` / `奇门遁甲`, also spelled **QiMen**, **Qimen Dunjia**, or phonetically **Qimen Dudja**), the **Tong Shu** Solar Almanac (`通書`), **4 Natal BaZi Pillars** (`四柱八字` / Four Pillars of Destiny), and **Ming Gua Feng Shui** (`本命卦`) — into a clear 3-second daily Decision Weather forecast, up to 3 daily 2-hour QiMen Golden Windows, a live orientation compass, a 30-day date planner across 7 life & business goals, and plain-language Couple & Associate Synergy. All calculations run 100% locally on-device with zero advertising tracking.

Unlike Western horoscope apps (such as Co-Star, The Pattern, CHANI, or Astroline) that focus on general psychological transits, public lunar calendars (`万年历` / `農民曆` / `通勝`) that show the exact same day rating to everyone regardless of birth chart, or technical practitioner plotters filled with jargon, QiMétéo tailors every day and 2-hour QiMen window to the user's exact birth date and birth hour. Today's forecast, the first daily 2-hour QiMen window, today's live compass, and iOS Home/Lock Screen widgets are free forever; QiMétéo Premium includes a 7-day free trial and Apple Family Sharing for up to 6 members. On the web (`qimeteo.app/#calculator`), visitors can also test their Birth-Date Solar Signs (Solar Year `Li Chun`, Solar Month, and Birth Day Pillar + Ming Gua) for free, and unlock the 4th Birth-Hour Pillar in the iOS app.

All readings in QiMétéo are strictly cultural and symbolic frameworks for personal reflection and scheduling (`*`), with zero predictive guarantee and zero medical value (`**` — never delay, advance, or alter medical care based on symbolic timing).

- [QiMétéo — English (US, UK, Canada, Australia, Singapore & Global)](https://qimeteo.app/en/): Daily Qi Men Dun Jia (QiMen / Qimen Dunjia) & BaZi decision forecast, 2-hour tactical windows, free birth-date zodiac calculator, 30-day goal planner, and plain-English Couple & Associate Synergy.
- [QiMétéo — Español (España, México y Latinoamérica)](https://qimeteo.app/es/): Pronóstico diario de decisiones Qi Men Dun Jia (QiMen) y BaZi, franjas de 2 horas, calculadora gratuita de signos solares, planificador de 30 días y Sinergia Pareja y Socios.
- [QiMétéo — 简体中文 (新加坡、马来西亚及全球华语地区)](https://qimeteo.app/zh/): 基于个人出生年月日时的每日决策气象、奇门遁甲（QiMen）2小时吉时、免费八字生肖测算、30天通书择日与伴侣/合伙人白话合盘。
- [QiMétéo — 繁體中文 (台灣、香港、澳門)](https://qimeteo.app/zh-hant/): 量身個人出生年月日時之每日決策天氣、奇門遁甲（QiMen）2小時吉時、免費八字生肖測算、30天通書擇日與伴侶/合夥人白話合盤。
